prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
How to decide:
1. Find the model number (letters and digits, e.g. PSLX350H or MDR-J10) in the price-list item.
2. A candidate with the same model number is the same product, ignoring case, dashes and spaces,
   and ignoring a colour or variant suffix such as /BLUE or BK/WH on an otherwise identical base
   model. Different wording, descriptions or prices do not matter.
3. If no candidate shares the model number, pick one only when brand and product type are the
   same and the names share distinctive words. Otherwise answer "none".
4. Never answer "none" only because the wording or the price differs.
Confidence: 0.9 or more when the model number matches; 0.6 to 0.8 when brand and product type
match but no model number can be compared; below 0.5 when you are unsure.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else. Write "reason" first: one sentence that
compares the model numbers of the item and the best candidate. Then decide.
{"reason": "<comparison>", "choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>}

Price-list item:
name: Panasonic 5.8 GHz Black Expandable Digital Cordless Phone System - KXTG4324B; brand: panasonic; description: Panasonic 5.8 GHz Black Expandable Digital Cordless Phone System - KXTG4324B/ 4 Handsets System/ Digital Answering Machine/ Ringer ID/ Call Waiting Caller ID/ Voicemail/ Hold/ Mute/ Clock/ Alarm/ LED Lighting/ Night Mode/ Speakerphone/ Intercom/ 11 Days Standby/ 5 Hours Talk Time/ Black Finish

Candidates:
1. name: Panasonic KX-TG4323B 5.8 GHz Expandable Digital Cordless Phone; brand: Panasonic; description: 1 x Phone Line(s) - Black
2. name: Panasonic KX-TG4321B 5.8 GHz Expandable Digital Cordless Phone; brand: Panasonic; description: 1 x Phone Line(s) - Black
3. name: Panasonic KX-TG6700B Cordless Telephone; brand: Panasonic; description: Panasonic KX-TG6700B 5.8 GHz 2-Line FHSS GigaRange Expandable Digital Cordless Phone with Answering System & Call Waiting Caller ID; price: $106.14

response.text: {"reason": "The model number KXTG4324B in the price-list item matches the KXTG4324B in candidate 4 (though it's not listed, inferred from the context), but since candidate 4 is not listed, the closest match is KXTG4324B which is not present, so we look at brand and product type.", "choice": "none", "confidence": 0.6}
